component.name: SeriesScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.top.playlistId = "" m.top.onSeriesSelect = invalid m.top.onBack = false m.seriesGrid = m.top.findNode("seriesGrid") m.seriesGrid.observeField("itemSelected", "onGridItemSelected") end sub
sub loadSeries(playlistId as string) m.top.playlistId = playlistId result = syncPlaylists(0) if result.ok items = [] for each playlist in result.data.playlists if playlist.id = playlistId or playlistId = "" for each series in playlist.series ? [] items.push({ id: series.id, title: series.title, poster: series.posterUrl, description: series.description, seasons: series.seasons }) end for end if end for m.seriesGrid.content = buildGridContent(items) end if end sub
sub onGridItemSelected() idx = m.seriesGrid.itemSelected if idx >= 0 item = m.seriesGrid.content.getChild(idx) m.top.onSeriesSelect = { title: item.title, seasons: item.seasons } end if end sub
sub onKeyDown(key as Integer) if key = 283 m.top.onBack = true end if end sub
